provenance: Authored as a separate evaluation specification from the stated Terraform refactor and authorization obligation. Scenario Terraform is reused from the implementation fixture catalog; authorship is not independent review.

review_protocol.goal: Independent expert validation of SABLE benchmark ground truth to determine: (1) logical asset continuity, and (2) least-privilege obligation preservation.
review_criteria: Reviewer must not be an author or contributor to SABLE code.
Reviewer inspects raw baseline and candidate HCL files independently.
Reviewer independently determines whether a unique logical successor exists.
Reviewer independently determines whether the candidate IAM policy satisfies the least-privilege obligation.
Reviewer must provide explicit technical rationale for every reviewed case.

independent_human_review.definition: External experts with no contribution to SABLE code, executing this protocol independently of the authors' expectations.

author_review.definition: Evaluations performed by SABLE authors or contributors; recorded as provenance only and never used for metrics. Evidence record: reports/SABLE_AUTHOR_REVIEW_2026-11-10.md.

ai_assisted_review.definition: Analyses produced with AI-tool assistance (including the SABLE engine itself); recorded as observations, never as review attestation.

independent_moved_only.description: Pure regex-based moved-block parser. Does not import or execute any SABLE modules (HCL parser, correspondence, or authorization). Predicts PRESERVED if a unique moved block targets the obligation asset; UNKNOWN otherwise.
independent_moved_only.limitations: Cannot evaluate policy semantics or detect authorization regressions (e.g., privilege widening, misbinding, or weakening).

B0_candidate_only.description: Ablation evaluating authorization on the candidate without correspondence resolution (evaluates original asset address directly).
B0_candidate_only.limitations: Reuses SABLE's evaluate_authorization engine; not an independent baseline.

B1_policy_scan_diff.description: Ablation comparing before/after effective permission sets without structural resource correspondence.
B1_policy_scan_diff.limitations: Reuses SABLE's evaluate_authorization engine; not an independent baseline.

B2_moved_evidence.description: Ablation using only HCL-parsed moves without correspondence scoring or policy check.
B2_moved_evidence.limitations: Reuses SABLE's python-hcl2 wrapper; does not verify policy security.

B3_structural_correspondence.description: Ablation executing SABLE correspondence ranking and selection without obligation projection.
B3_structural_correspondence.limitations: Reuses SABLE's rank and choose algorithms; omits authorization projection.

B4_composite_ablation.description: Composite internal ablation combining B0+B1+B2+B3 with policy-target relationships. Must NOT be described as an independent comparator because it reuses SABLE's correspondence ranker and authorization engine.
B4_composite_ablation.limitations: Implementation leakage: shares identical AST/graph, correspondence scoring, and authorization code with SABLE.

cases.description: aws_s3_bucket.customer_data renamed to aws_s3_bucket.cdata with a moved{} block. Policy updated. Strongest signal set → PRESERVED.

obligation.authority_source: explicit benchmark policy + Terraform IAM policy document

authored_expectation.rationale: Explicit moved block maps the protected bucket address to cdata; physical bucket identity and policy target are retained.

cases.description: customer_data split into customer_data_hot and customer_data_cold. No unique successor → UNKNOWN.

obligation.authority_source: explicit benchmark policy + Terraform IAM policy document

authored_expectation.rationale: Two new bucket resources divide the prior logical asset; the case provides no unique logical successor rule.

cases.description: Actions correct but Resource changed from specific bucket to * → REGRESSED (widening).

obligation.authority_source: explicit benchmark policy + Terraform IAM policy document

authored_expectation.rationale: The original logical bucket remains, but the policy resource scope becomes wildcard rather than bucket-specific.

cases.description: A different bucket (logs_bucket) satisfies the local policy predicate but is the wrong logical asset → REGRESSED.

obligation.authority_source: explicit benchmark policy + Terraform IAM policy document

authored_expectation.rationale: REGRESSED: the required actions are re-bound to logs_bucket, whose Asset tag ('logs') is categorically incompatible with the customer-data obligation; the successor stays unresolved because customer_data_new shows no continuity evidence (different bucket name, different tag, no moved block, and no policy reference).

cases.description: Three S3 buckets with matching Asset tag and Stage, scores too close → UNKNOWN.

obligation.authority_source: explicit benchmark policy + Terraform IAM policy document

authored_expectation.rationale: Three candidates carry equivalent logical tags and no unique identity evidence selects one.

cases.description: New bucket has different physical identity and no moved, tag, or application-reference evidence; successor is unresolved → UNKNOWN.

obligation.authority_source: explicit benchmark policy + Terraform IAM policy document

authored_expectation.rationale: Replacement has different physical identity and no continuity evidence; the intended successor cannot be established from this case.
